metadata.description: Personal, application-agnostic Claude Code skills + plugins.

plugins.name: bug-hunt
plugins.description: Adversarial, expert-level bug hunt for any application — recon, static, runtime, and adversarial probes driven by a researched bug taxonomy.

plugins.name: deai
plugins.description: Rewrite AI-generated text so it reads as genuinely human-written in a professional register — strip LLM signatures while preserving meaning, never fabricating.

plugins.name: chaos
plugins.description: API-focused chaos engineering — hypothesis-driven fault injection via a shipped zero-dependency fault proxy + black-box verification of the resilience-mechanism fingerprint (breaker/retry/fallback/shed), strict blast-radius + auto-disarm safety, regression test per weakness.

plugins.name: pentest
plugins.description: Authorized penetration test — full engagement lifecycle (rules-of-engagement gate → recon → enumeration → threat model/attack tree → exploitation → vulnerability chaining → post-exploitation → professional report) aligned to PTES, NIST SP 800-115, OWASP WSTG/ASVS/API Top 10, and MITRE ATT&CK. Adversary emulation toward a crown-jewel objective with minimum-necessary non-destructive proof, CVSS scoring, and a retest check per finding. Authorization is a hard first gate.

plugins.name: llm-eval
plugins.description: Build and run a rigorous evaluation of any LLM app/agent — and make the eval itself trustworthy. Deterministic-first metrics, judges validated against human labels (Cohen's κ) before trusted, claim-decomposition faithfulness/hallucination detection, judge-bias controls (position/verbosity/self-preference), and statistical honesty (paired-difference + confidence intervals + fixed temperature — never a win on noise). Ships a zero-dependency eval harness; no promptfoo/DeepEval/RAGAS needed.

plugins.name: ui-verify
plugins.description: Prove a deployed web UI actually WORKS, not just loads — 'deployed ≠ working'. Asserts a verification ladder (loads → renders real content → wired to backend → functional end-to-end): semantic content oracles, console + network fail-gates (incl. wrong-endpoint detection), SSE streaming verification, visual baseline diff, axe a11y — with deterministic waits + retry-quorum so a pass means a pass, and a structured evidence report. Ships a zero-dependency CDP driver (Node 22 + Chrome, no npm/Playwright); also uses the chrome-devtools MCP or Playwright when present.

plugins.name: debug
plugins.description: Find the ROOT CAUSE of a failure by disciplined hypothesis-and-falsification with shipped instrumentation — never fix before you understand. Distributed-systems-aware (containers/LB/cross-VCN/IAM eventual-consistency/shared resources): reproduce → observe → hypothesize → falsify by toggling → bisect → confirm → prove the fix → regression-guard, with a Confirmed-vs-Suspected gate (correlation ≠ cause) and a localization decision tree. Ships a zero-dependency boundary tracer (DNS/TCP/TLS/HTTP/auth/content probes + working-vs-failing differential).

plugins.name: worktree-isolation
plugins.description: Advisory standard. The primary clone is a coordination point, not a workspace — isolate every line of work (yours and agents') in its own git worktree so parallel lines never collide. Fires when a change is about to land while other work is in flight, in a repo with live worktrees, or when dispatching agents that write to the tree.

plugins.name: project-structure
plugins.description: Advisory standard. How a repo is laid out and how files/modules are named, so every project looks the same and generated code has one obvious home — colocate by feature, one-module-one-responsibility, no utils/misc junk drawers. The judgment-layer counter to AI-slop sprawl that linters can't catch. Reference layouts for Python/TS/Rust.

plugins.name: github-api-discipline
plugins.description: Advisory standard + shipped reference impl. When build/deploy code reads files from another GitHub repo at runtime: one bulk zipball fetch per repo (not per-file /contents), honor rate-limit headers, share fetched content, use an App token not a PAT. Keeps you under the 15000/hr installation limit. Ships a drop-in zipball fetcher + backoff helper.

plugins.name: quality-verify-hook
plugins.description: Prove a project's static-analysis git hooks actually fire on bad code — works with lefthook or the pre-commit framework. Stages a known-bad fixture and asserts non-zero exit; stages a known-good fixture and asserts zero. Catches the silently-misconfigured-hook class ('hook silence ≠ hook working'). Ships a zero-dependency, self-locating Python verifier + fixtures.

plugins.name: quality-stack-setup
plugins.description: Wire a repo's lint/static-analysis/test stack so local checks and CI can't drift: lefthook git hooks (pre-commit auto-fixers + pre-push full verify) calling a justfile that is the single source of truth CI also runs. Language-agnostic (ruff/skylos · prettier/eslint/fallow · clippy/rustfmt) and CI-agnostic — ships both a GitHub Actions and a Bitbucket Pipelines backstop.

plugins.name: suppression-discipline
plugins.description: Advisory standard. Every static-analysis suppression — # skylos: ignore, # noqa, # type: ignore, // eslint-disable, @ts-expect-error, #[allow(...)], //nolint — must carry an inline rationale; a bare suppression is a quality failure to fix, and --no-verify / LEFTHOOK=0 is never the answer to a finding. Fires when an ignore is added/proposed or hooks are bypassed.

plugins.name: feature-workflow
plugins.description: Directory-based feature lifecycle: capture (idea.md) → plan → ship (shipped.md), with status by file-presence, an orthogonal state overlay (active/paused/replaced/abandoned), epics, a dependency graph, and an auto-generated DASHBOARD.md (PostToolUse hook). Reviews run through a provider-agnostic channel — a local Claude subagent by default (no CI, no API keys), or GitHub / Bitbucket PRs, or none. Adapted from Court Schuett's feature-workflow; engine ported intact (146 tests), GitHub-CI review path replaced by a pluggable seam.
